about.title: What is Security 51?
paragraphs: Security 51 is an atmospheric horror checkpoint simulator developed and published by Alawar. You screen staff in an underground Area 51 facility, verify access, watch the elevator, and decide who may enter, who must be stopped, and which threat cannot be allowed back outside.

The launch build layers documents, clearance, time, headcount, photographs, body and organ scans, fingerprints, blood analysis, quarantine, infection control, field operations, and delayed consequences. Daily instructions can override the default workflow, so these guides teach a verification stack instead of one permanent answer table.
